thread:
Maria: main is red right after merge of PR #8423. Failing job: unit-tests-gpu (tests/unit/gpu_kv_cache_test). CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/999888
ci-bot: Pipeline failed on main (run 999888). Job: unit-tests-gpu. Exit code: 1. Log snippet:
``n[ RUN      ] GPUKVCache.AllocEdgeCase
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```
Noah: @channel taking a look. Jun, can you grab logs and try a local repro?
Jun: grabbing full logs now and will run the same test in the CI CUDA image. Maria, did your PR touch cache eviction or allocator code?
Maria: only tweaked eviction threshold in runtime/cache.cc (small change) — no allocator changes intentionally.
Olga: FYI I saw a similar segfault yesterday on cuda-12.1 when doing local kv cache experiments. looked like a free-after-evict race.
Noah: quick check: can someone re-run the job? /rerun 999888
ci-bot: Re-run requested by Noah. New run queued: 999889
Jun: starting looped runs locally on a CI-equivalent node with cuda-12.1 image.
ci-bot: Run 999889 finished 3 still failing with same segfault in GPUKVCache.AllocEdgeCase.
Jun: reproduced locally, same stack trace. Suspect eviction threshold change exposed an allocator race path under certain CUDA driver behavior.
Maria: I can revert #8423 to see if that clears main. Want me to push a revert?
Noah: please do revert to unblock main. We can bisect later if needed.
Maria: reverted PR #8423 and pushed revert to main. Triggering pipeline.
ci-bot: Revert commit pushed by Maria. New run: 999890
ci-bot: Run 999890 completed 3 unit-tests-gpu: PASSED (all tests green).
Noah: revert fixed it. Good work. Jun, can you open an issue to track a safe reintroduce plan (flagged rollout + added regression test)? Maria, please open a follow-up PR that gates the change behind a feature flag and adds a small eviction stress test.
Jun: will open an infra/allocator ticket and add a flakiness CI job for gpu_kv_cache_test to catch this earlier.
Olga: tagging allocator leads in the incident notes and adding repro steps + cuda image details.
Maria: closing my merge PR and creating the follow-up PR now with test matrix for cuda-11/12 and the feature flag. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Noah: thanks team 3 closing this triage. If anything else crops up, ping eng-infra-oncall or @Noah.
